The Problem

Unreliable Hosting Kills Automations and Costs You Clients

Cheap shared hosting is the hidden destroyer of contractor tech stacks. Your website slows to a crawl during peak hours. Your form submissions stop routing. Your automated follow-up sequences fail silently. A $5/month hosting plan is costing you thousands in lost automation reliability — and you may not even know it's happening.

When a customer fills out your contact form at 9pm and your automation is supposed to send them a confirmation text and book an appointment, any hosting or uptime failure in that chain means the customer gets nothing. They assume you're disorganized, unresponsive, or don't want the work. They call someone else by morning.

Our managed hosting platform is purpose-built for contractor technology stacks — websites, lead capture systems, CRM integrations, and automation workflows. We host everything under your brand on a subdomain structure, monitor uptime around the clock, and handle all the technical infrastructure so you never have to think about it.

What You Get

Infrastructure You Can Count On. Support You Can Reach.

98.5% Uptime SLA

We back our infrastructure with a formal uptime commitment. If your site or system goes down, we know before you do — our monitoring alerts our team instantly so issues are resolved before they impact your leads.

Subdomain Routing

We host your tools and client-facing apps under clean branded subdomains (yourname.buildrightpros.com or your own domain), keeping everything organized, professional, and easy to manage as your tech stack grows.

Managed Infrastructure

SSL certificates, security patches, software updates, database backups, and performance optimization — all handled by our team on a regular maintenance schedule. You own your data; we manage the technical layer.
